articles.summary: 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year revenue and operating income growth Electromed, Inc. (“Electromed”) (NYSE American: ELMD), a leader in innovative airway clearance technologies, today announced financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 (“Q1 FY 2027”). Q1 FY 2027 Company Highlights Net revenues were $18.7 million in Q1 FY 2027, a 10.6% increase from $16.9 million in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year, driven by a 17.6% increase in the core homecare market. Operating income increased to $3.5 million, a 30.7% increase from the first quarter of the prior fiscal year, and 18.7% of net revenues. Net income was $2.8 million, or $0.32 per diluted share, representing an increase of 29.3%, compared to $2.1 million, or $0.25 per diluted share in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year. “We delivered our 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year revenue and operating income growth, with double-digit revenue growth, a 30.7% increase in operating income
articles.title: Electromed, Inc. Delivers Continued Growth in Fiscal 2027 First Quarter
